column6: Q2 FY2026 10-Q filed 2026-07-31 showing continued operations, revenue $190.7M; public company, active clinical diagnostics business.
Q2 2026 earnings release (2026-08-10) reports revenue, sales-force counts, and updated FY2026 guidance despite a shrinking sales force; company remains fully operating.
Q2 2026 results (2026-08-05) confirm completed 5 MW Cove Fort, UT upgrade (June 2026) and continued Cove Fort 2/North development on Utah BLM leases; page already scoped to the Utah plant operations.
Q2 2026 8-K press release (2026-08-06): revenue 5.8M dollars, up 470 pct YoY, 24.6M backlog, AFRL STRATFI award exercised; active public defense-AI company.

Now Bed Bath and Beyond, Inc. (NYSE: BBBY); Q2 2026 10-Q/earnings show revenue growth and active acquisitions (rebranding to Neighborhood Intelligence planned Aug 2026); work continues under successor corporate name per ruling 3.
Company newsroom dated 2026-07-23: MX named to CNBC 2026 World's Top Fintech Companies list (announced 2026-07-22) and reports continued platform expansion including an AI assistant.
Neighbor Storage, Inc. Form D (accession 0001712600-26-000005) filed 2026-07-08 from Lehi HQ; Rule 506(b) exempt offering, first sale 2026-07-07.
Official 2026 calendar posts Fall Start housing move-in 2026-09-25, orientation 2026-09-26, and NeumontX campus event 2026-08-07; school is running a current admissions cycle.
DOE STTR Phase I DE-SC0025824 ($200k) award start 2025-02-18 for THz AR coatings; a 2024 Phase II on superconducting flex cables (DE-SC0023907) runs through 2026-09-09.

BioUtah dated 2025-02-20 lists Nephro Novus among Altitude Lab Demo Day presenters; company site is undated Squarespace branding, no grants/trials/filings found, and the April 2026 Demo Day page does not name it.
Company press dated 2025-09-10 announces the 2026 Global Culture Report released at Influence Greatness; research from 38,929 respondents, 1,500+ staff described as ongoing.

PRWeb 2025-05-19: Husqvarna launches professional irrigation combining B-hyve with Hydro-Rain/ETwater; Stuart Eyring quoted as CEO of Gardena Division BU Orbit. Work continues under Husqvarna (ruling 3).

Owlet Inc. (NYSE: OWLT) Q2 2026 results dated 2026-08-11: revenue $33.9M, up 29.9% YoY, subscription $3.2M; public company still selling FDA-cleared infant monitors. Wiki Stage says private; it is public.

Utah Business 2026-06-16 Executive Excellence profile of COO Jessica Elwell describing present-tense OxEon manufacturing scale-up and DOE/DoD engagement; ECS 2025 meeting abstract also reports EquinOx (DE-EE0011305) in progress.
PR Newswire 2025-09-18: $74M Series C led by noa to scale Hive autonomous-building platform; work continues, not a terminal event.

Parkinson's News Today 2026-05-22: Light for PD Phase 3 (NCT04453033) last-patient visit complete, 351 enrolled; topline at World Parkinson Congress 2026-05-26 and FDA De Novo planned. Trial completion is a milestone, not a terminal event for the company.
Company newsroom 2026-05-07 launches Cloud Ready upskilling program; CEO Erin Gajdalo quoted. HQ now described as Westlake, Texas; Utah Farmington page may be stale on location.
SiliconANGLE 2026-03-18: Qualtrics at X4 2026 announced synthetic US consumer panels and Research Hub; product work continues under Silver Lake/CPP ownership (ruling 3).
PR Newswire 2025-12-15: Podium launches Jerry 2.0 AI employee for auto/HVAC/medspa; OpenAI case study cites 10,000+ rooftops and 300% YoY AI revenue growth. Lehi HQ still operating.

St. George News: 50th-anniversary open house Wednesday 2025-10-15 at the St. George plant; CEO describes ongoing F-35 work, F-47 design-phase parts, and Aero Sense acquisition. A 2026 America-250 sponsored piece reports ~360 local employees but carried no dateline.
